schema_file: question_schema_v7_file layer with locators stimuli rubric and provenance.json
procedure_file: extraction_procedure_social_addendum_v1.4_social science Classes 6-10 on top of procedure v2.md

second_method.method: independent count of answer-side keys (79 numbered keys + 1 unnumbered match block(s)) + 1 question(s) with no printed key

count_gate.note: No difficulty distribution table is printed in this LBA -> quota_table 'absent' (ruling R-E6). Question side labels 1-81 monotonic, no gaps or duplicates. Answer side 1-40, [match block, 15 rows], 42-80; q81 (draw) has no key. Difficulty per question: easy 55, average 2, difficult 18, untagged 6.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 55 (heading, LO) 56-60; A pdf 154 (heading, keys 1-5) 155-159.

Sections: s1 MCQ q1-5; s2 fill q6-25; s3 T/F q26-40 (no answer spaces printed); s4 '41. Match the following correctly (easy)' q41 (15 rows; Q-side labels garbled — j) twice, column B 'a.' twice); s5 one mark q42-50 vsa; s6 two marks q51-60 sa; s7 three marks q61-70 sa; s8 four marks q71-81 la.

TOPICS (ruling R-E7): EVS map v1 evs-4-13 sections s00 Introduction (not tickable), s01 Respiration, s02 Blood circulation, s03 Digestion, s04 Excretion. Each question tagged by its content to one tickable section ('content', 'high'), else ALL four tickable sections ('content', 'low') — sense organs, skin, bones, hygiene, the whole body; s00 never used. Mapping listed in the unit summary.

Keys: fill keys print the completed sentence (stored verbatim as the fill value); keys 51-80 print a paragraph on the line after the number (one prose answer), q51 four bullets, q77 heading + 5 bullets, q80 instruction + 'Include:' + 6 bullets (labels only; flagged 'answer is a diagram').
Untagged stems printed without a tag: q58, q60, q67, q70, q77, q80 -> 'no difficulty tag'. 'skin.Average)' (q65) read as a tag. q81 draw -> 'no answer printed'.
Transcription: evs_auto.py rules (as evs-4-01) + the overrides in build file build_13.py; marks per ruling R-E5; topic per R-E3.

questions.subject: evs
questions.text:
Match the following correctly
A: (a) Ear; b) Eye; c) Tongue; d) Nose; e) Heart; f) Skin; g) Kidney; h) Lungs; i) Small intestine; j) Stomach; j) Oesophagus; k) Stethoscope; l) large intestine; m) Bones and muscles; n) urethra
B: a. to see things; b. to hear sounds; c. to smell; d. to taste; e. to feel heat and cold; f. the organ that pumps blood; g. Organ used for respiration; h. Filtering blood and building urine; a. Partial digestion of food; i. digest the food and absorb the nutrients; o) removes the urine; j) carries food to the stomach; l) Giving shape and structure to the body; m) removes the undigested food; n) Instrument to check the heart rate
questions.text_as_printed: Match the following correctly (easy) A                              B (a) Ear                        a. to see things b) Eye                        b. to hear sounds c) Tongue                     c. to smell d) Nose                       d. to taste e) Heart                      e. to feel heat and cold f) Skin                        f. the organ that pumps blood g) Kidney                     g. Organ used for respiration h) Lungs                      h. Filtering blood and building urine i) Small intestine              a. Partial digestion of food j) Stomach                           i. digest the food and absorb the nutrients j) Oesophagus                  o) removes the urine k) Stethoscope                  j) carries food to the stomach l) large intestine               l) Giving shape and structure to the body m) Bones and muscles              m) removes the undigested food n) urethra                        n) Instrument to check the heart rate
questions.section_signal: Match the Following

pairs.right: digest the food and absorb the nutrients
instrument to check the heart rate
giving shape and structure to the body

questions.answer_as_printed: (a) Ear → b. to hear sounds; (b) Eye → a. to see things; (c) Tongue → d. to taste; (d) Nose → c. to smell; (e) Heart → f. the organ that pumps blood; (f) Skin → e. to feel heat and cold; (g) Kidney → h. filtering blood and building urine; (h) Lungs → g. organ used for respiration; (i) Small intestine → i. digest the food and absorb the nutrients; (j) Stomach → a. partial digestion of food; (k) Oesophagus → j. carries food to the stomach; (l) Stethoscope → n. instrument to check the heart rate; (m) Large intestine → m. removes the undigested food; (n) Bones and muscles → l. giving shape and structure to the body; (o) Urethra → o. removes the urine
